name: Ichigo
source:
Addicted to studying, a honour student elder sister.

Likes her younger brother secretly, but thinking ethically, restrains herself.

If cannot pursue things which she doesn't understand, she cannot be satisfied.

"Until you become an adult, do as I tell you. If you do so, you will definitely become a respectable member of the society."

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=850479]Getchu[/url]]
